subject: Mutual action plan & exec intro to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Watson <ewatson@retailops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & exec intro to unblock pilot

Hi Emily —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery + suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

- Outcome you care about: reduce model latency on search re-rank to <150ms p95 across peak traffic and cut inference costs by ~40% vs current infra.
- Data constraints: production data stays in AWS us-west-2; SOC2 and audit log requirements called out.
- Metrics & success criteria: 95th p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and 1 week pilot with representative traffic.
- Risks: model quantization impact on quality, integration with your API gateway/auth.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Exec handshake (VP/CTO) to agree on pilot gates and procurement runway.
2) Technical deep-dive (infra + security) with our engineering lead.
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) that lists owners, dates, and acceptance criteria.

Proposed windows for VP/CTO handshake (all times PT):
- Thu Mar 14, 10:00–10:30 
- Thu Mar 14, 15:00–15:30 
- Fri Mar 15, 09:00–09:30

I attached a 1‑page MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) that we can iterate on — happy to own the first draft and update after the exec call. If none of those times work, share a couple slots and we’ll prioritize.

Also looping in Karthik (cc) — our solutions lead — who will run the technical deep-dive once the execs align.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel — mutual action plan stub)

From: Emily Watson <ewatson@retailops.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@retailops.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & exec intro to unblock pilot

Aditya —

Thanks for the recap, that looks right from our side. Jacob (our CTO) is out of town Tuesday but available on Thursday afternoon PT. The two best slots for us are:
- Thu Mar 14, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Fri Mar 15, 09:00–09:30 PT

A couple notes from Jacob:
- Please include a short 10-minute agenda for the exec call focusing on pilot gates and procurement timelines.
- We’ll need a checklist for security documentation (SOC2 evidence, data flow diagrams, and access controls) ahead of the tech deep-dive so our security team can triage.

Also looping in our procurement lead (Ishan) offline — Ishan will confirm contract review timelines.

If you can confirm Thu 15:00, we’ll lock the calendar and send invites.

Best,
Emily
Director of Product
RetailOps

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Watson <ewatson@retailops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & exec intro to unblock pilot

Emily — thanks, Thu 15:00 PT works for us. I’ve penciled it and will send the calendar invite after you confirm. Quick agenda (10–15 min):

1) Introductions & outcome scoping (Aditya, Emily, Jacob) — 3 min
2) Pilot gates & timeline (Marissa, Redwood) — 4 min
3) Procurement runway & high-level commercial ask (Aditya) — 3 min
4) Immediate technical blockers to surface for the follow-up deep-dive (Karthik) — 3–5 min

Attachments I’m sharing now: SOW_template.pdf (for procurement), and the MAP_v1.xlsx as the working doc. We’ll also share a short security pack with data flow diagram and SOC2 checklist before the deep-dive — Karthik will own that deliverable.

Action items:
- I’ll send the invite for Thu Mar 14, 15:00–15:30 PT and include Jacob, Emily, Ishan (procurement), Marissa, and Karthik.
- Karthik: will prepare the security checklist + one-page infra runbook for the deep-dive.
- Marissa: will cover pilot acceptance criteria and SLA ask on the call.

Confirm when you’re happy and I’ll lock.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_template.pdf (PDF — procurement template); MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Watson <ewatson@retailops.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Mar 2029 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & exec intro to unblock pilot

Emily / Aditya —

I can join Thu at 15:00 PT and will present the draft acceptance criteria (short checklist) on the call. Karthik will bring the infra runbook draft.

Quick note: we’ll have our engineering lead on the deep-dive (Ana Muñoz) so please share any specific telemetry or sample traffic numbers you want included in the pilot.

Forwarding the MAP_v1.xlsx from Aditya for reference — I’ve added a few owner rows and dates that we can adjust on the call.

See you Thursday,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
